messages:
cve-bot: [ALERT] New CVE reported affecting a transitive JS dependency in several services: CVE-2026-0143 — prototype deserialization vuln in `protobufjs` (>=6.11.0 <6.14.2). CVSS: 8.1 (High). EPSS: 0.72. PoC: https://github.com/example/poc
lena: @here fyi — which services pin protobufjs directly or pull it transitively? need quick exposure map
ajay: api-proxy and ingestion-worker pull it via `grpc-tools` (transitive). tagging owners: @maria for ingestion, @lorenzo for api-proxy
maria: confirmed ingestion-worker package-lock.json shows protobufjs@6.12.0. It's a transitive via grpc-tools@1.9.2. No direct import in our code.
lorenzo: api-proxy uses a prebuilt image that includes node_modules from build step. I can check image manifest; likely 6.13.0. Running quick scan now.
sec-oncall: exploit maturity high (PoC), EPSS elevated. Recommend patch asap for internet-facing components. If immediate patch not possible, apply mitigations and increase logging.
ajay: mitigation options: 1) upgrade dependency to patched 6.14.2 and rebuild images, 2) add runtime WAF rule to drop malformed protobuf payloads, 3) restrict ingress to proxy endpoints during rollout.
maria: patch path: for ingestion-worker change grpc-tools -> bump or add npm-force-resolutions to force protobufjs@6.14.2, rebuild container. Patch test on staging first.
lorenzo: image check: api-proxy image (sha:sha256:...) contains protobufjs@6.13.1 — need rebuild. ETA for rebuild + canary deploy ~ 2 hours if infra free.
lena: priority = P1 for api-proxy (internet-facing), P2 for ingestion-worker (internal but processes external data). @sec-oncall coordinate canary and rollback policy.
sec-oncall: will open incident ticket INC-2026-0298, set runbook: patch -> canary 10% -> monitor logs for malformed deserializations -> full rollout. Also enable debug audit logging for proto parsing in staging and prod-canary for 6 hours.
ajay: quick commands for owners:
```
# force resolution (ingestion)
npm install --package-lock-only
npx npm-force-resolutions && npm ci
# rebuild image
docker build -t registry.prod/redwood/ingestion-worker:$BUILD
# kubectl
kubectl set image deploy/ingestion-worker ingestion-worker=registry.prod/redwood/ingestion-worker:$BUILD
kubectl rollout status deploy/ingestion-worker
```
maria: note on KMS/RBAC: no key rotation needed for this vuln. KMS usage unaffected. Audit logs: enable extra parsing logs to S3 for 48h.
lorenzo: will start rebuild now and push a canary tag. ping me in #eng-oncall if any flakiness after rollout.
lena: thanks. please post status updates in this thread. once canary stable, we schedule full rollout and close INC.
ajay: logging query to track potential exploitation attempts (Elasticsearch):
```
index=app-logs proto_parse_error OR "unexpected field" OR "malformed protobuf"
| stats count by source_ip, service
```
maria: staging patch applied, running integration tests. will post results in 20m.
lorenzo: api-proxy canary up at 10% — no errors seen so far (10m). monitoring dashboard filte rs OK.
lena: good work team. follow through on canary window and then full rollout. remember to update dependency manifest so future builds pick patched version. :thumbsup:
